models.description: An activity feed entry recording a change event on an entity. Activities track who changed what, when, and how — forming the audit log for tasks, deals, projects, invoices, and other resources.

models.description: Approval policy defining who approves time entries, absences, or expenses. Configures the set of approvers and whether unanimous approval is required. Auto-creates approval_status records for each approver when a submission is made.

attributes.description: Timestamp when the approval policy was archived, or null if active.

attributes.description: The display name of the approval policy.

attributes.description: Numeric identifier for the approval policy type: 1 = absence, 2 = budget, 3 = deal.

models.description: An approval policy assignment links an approval policy to a specific target (person or budget).

attributes.description: The type of target this policy is assigned to: 'Person' for absence approvals or 'Quote' for budget approvals.

attributes.name: approved_at
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this approval status was approved. Null while pending or rejected.

attributes.description: Timestamp at which this approval status was rejected. Null while pending or approved.

attributes.name: target_type
